name: Crichtonpelta
sum: Crichtonpelta is an ankylosaurid from the Cenomanian Sunjiawan Formation of Liaoning, China, known from skulls and skeletons.
holotype: BXGMV0012, a skull — Sunjiawan Formation, near Beipiao, Liaoning, probably early Cenomanian (about 99–95 Ma).
material: A referred skeleton without skull (BXGMV0012-1), a skull-less specimen and a fourth specimen (G20090034) from the same quarry.
biology: Known from skulls and postcrania; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Arbour and Currie 2016
